'''Santhe/Sienar Technologies''', owned by the [[Santhe Corporation/Legends|Santhe Corporation]], was a massive umbrella corporation based on the planet [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] that manufactures an exceptionally wide range of vehicles and weapons. Originally [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]], Santhe/Sienar Technologies provided numerous starships for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for many millennia. A short-lived subsidiary, [[Sienar Design Systems/Legends|Sienar Design Systems]], produced the [[Scimitar/Legends|Sith Infiltrator]]. Though they denied any involvement in the ship's design, SDS was forced to shut down due to intense scrutiny from the Senate. A century before the Battle of Yavin, the Sienars united with the [[Santhe family/Legends|Santhe family]], who owned [[Santhe Security]], due to an arranged marriage.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], RSS produced many vehicles for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], much to the disdain of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Shortly after the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] took control, the Senate ordered the dissolution of RSS. The Emperor quickly revived the company as [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] and placed it under the control of [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]]. SFS quickly became one of the largest and most prolific [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] manufacturers. Its chief rivals for Imperial military contracts were [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. Later, Sienar would form his [[Sienar Advanced Projects Laboratory/Legends|Advanced Projects Laboratory]] (whose purpose was very similar to SDS). This firm is responsible for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]]. Sienar was the CEO for many years of SFS, but was killed in an assassination.

Lady [[Valles Santhe]] of the [[Santhe family/Legends|Santhes]] took direct control of the company, following the assassination of Raith Sienar, and operated it after the collapse of the Empire. She then created [[Sienar Army Systems]] when the Emperor Palpatine was reborn in the body of a clone. After the defeat of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], the company began supplying vessels to all buyers, including the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

Santhe/Sienar originally did not invest in the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authoriy]]. However, the company realized they could not ignore the large discount on raw materials available to their competitors, and invested as a [[voting sponsor]] following the establishment of the Corporate Sector.<ref name="HSCS" /> 

Santhe/Sienar also maintained its own highly skilled security force, which, more often than not, quietly "reassigned" employees who were identified as spies, who spoke out against the Empire, or who otherwise performed actions that might endanger Sienar's relations with the Imperial government.<ref>[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook|''Rebellion Era Sourcebook'']]</ref>
